text_block_list.name: Academy PA
text_block_list.text:
Trainer<n><username>, please<n>
come to the director's office<n>immediately.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
The announcement sounds serious, so I<n>make my
way to the director's office in<n>something of a
fluster.

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text: Please enter.

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text: Do take a seat.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
The silence is downright unsettling! As<n>the
wordless minutes start to feel like<n>hours...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
...I grow more and more uneasy. Has<n>something
terrible happened?

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text: Gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
We called you here today to express our<n>
gratitude to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Your trainee<n><chrname>...

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's put on a brilliant display<n>throughout
this vital third year in her<n>Twinkle Series career!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
We've no doubt that the track she<n>blazed will
serve as a shining beacon for<n>not only her
classmates, but the next<n>generation as well!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
As such, we are... INCREDIBLY grateful!<n>Splendid
work, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
Right! Also... Expectations! I greatly look<n>forward
to the unprecedented glory<n>you're sure to achieve
in the future!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to thank you for your continued<n>efforts as
well. Please don't hesitate to<n>let me know if
there's anything I can<n>assist you with.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
It seems all they had in store was a heap<n>of praise!
I'm very appreciative, of<n>course, but something's
still bugging me.
choice_data_list: What was with that awkward silence?

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text: A surprise! Naturally!

text_block_list.name: Директор Акикава
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I figured building a little suspense<n>would
sweeten the payoff!

text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry. I did try to stop her...

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
...There's a thing or three I'd like to<n>question, but
I'm happy to know I'm<n>appreciated.

text_block_list.name: Монолог
text_block_list.text:
Later, I tell <chrname> about<n>what
happened and we share in the joy!
